objective: Upgrade all npm libraries, then complete stages 1, 2 and 3 of the self-hosted v1 gap analysis
releaseGate: A new operator installs, invites an editor, models and publishes to a real website, recovers a mistake, upgrades and restores a backup without manual database edits

dependencies.requirement: Upgrade every workspace direct dependency to registry latest and refresh transitive dependencies
evidence: All workspace direct packages upgraded with pnpm -r update --latest; pnpm-lock.yaml refreshed
pnpm outdated -r --format json reports no outdated direct dependencies
MIT license metadata in all workspace manifests
GraphQL 17 / Yoga 5 internal SDL with generated resolver and client types replaces incompatible type-graphql decorators
TypeScript 7, Tailwind 4 Vite integration, Vite React plugin and Babel transform migration
React resizable panels v4 API and persisted layout migration; matchblade evolve API migration

dependencies.requirement: Verify typecheck, lint, coverage, build, audit, generated clients, and registry freshness
evidence: pnpm typecheck: backend, frontend, shared and strict browser-test compilation pass
pnpm lint: 340 files pass without errors or warnings
pnpm test:coverage: backend 188, frontend 97 and shared 56 tests pass with unchanged coverage gates
Both production Docker images build; complete disposable deployment verification passes
pnpm --filter backend schema:test passes; API and database code generation reproduces identical artifacts
pnpm audit --json: zero vulnerabilities; pnpm outdated -r --format json: no outdated direct dependencies

dataSafety.requirement: Shared server-side content and settings validation including list ancestry
evidence: shared/src/content.ts and shared/src/node-settings.ts: strict shared validators and inferred domain types
Frontend property forms derive from shared validators
Value and settings mutations validate in serialized transactions; invalidating settings edits preserve existing values
backend/src/security/project-access.ts validates exact ordered ancestor list instances
Imports validate typed content before commit
backend/src/resolvers/content-validation.test.ts and backend/src/services/node-settings-validation.test.ts

dataSafety.requirement: Validate complete generated schemas before committing model changes and preview destructive changes
evidence: backend/src/services/public-schema.ts and schema-types.ts share exact schema construction between validation and serving
Model inserts, updates, deletes, settings changes and imports validate the full GraphQL schema and content before transaction commit
Generated filter/type collisions, invalid names, duplicate siblings, invalid hierarchy and incompatible content/list ancestry changes roll back without update events
Empty projects and lists expose valid schemas; subtree moves refresh descendant depths
backend/src/services/model-validation.test.ts: 14 regression cases, including media, fractional alpha, settings collisions and import rollback
Project-scoped deletion previews count fields, cascading values, list items and media; confirmation uses a fingerprint rechecked under the project lock
The shared deletion dialog waits for acknowledgement, displays errors, refreshes stale previews and requires explicit reconfirmation
backend/src/services/deletion-impact.test.ts and frontend/src/components/ui/deletion-dialog.test.tsx

dataSafety.requirement: Fix nested list scoping, empty items, underscore filters, ordering and pagination
evidence: backend/src/services/content-lists.test.ts reproduced the defects before fixing them
Nested list queries constrain the exact parent path; filters support underscores; sorting precedes pagination; empty admin list items retain empty child arrays

dataSafety.requirement: Durable save feedback and pending edit protection
evidence: frontend/src/state/save-queue.ts serializes saves, retains unconfirmed edits in account/project-scoped local storage, and preserves the exact base version until acknowledgement
Values, article text, field names and field properties share save status, retry, conflict review and explicit resolution; pending edits trigger unload protection and block history restore
Unreadable recovery data is preserved; storage failures are visible; creation and rename dialogs wait for their mutation before closing; form errors retain entered values
frontend/src/state/save-queue.test.ts, save-status.test.tsx and content-history.test.tsx exercise acknowledgement, newer queued drafts, failure/reload recovery and explicit conflict choices

dataSafety.requirement: Concurrent edit detection, revision history and restore
evidence: database/migrations/003-content-revisions.sql adds row edit versions, a monotonic project version and immutable API-visible content revision records
Required expectedRevision tokens protect values, fields and properties; scalar creation checks prevent concurrent duplicates
All accepted content/model/settings/list/import writes capture snapshots in the same transaction, including a migrated-project baseline
Content history supports paging, inspection and confirmed atomic restore; restore checks expectedVersion, validates the model and issues fresh row versions
Media referenced by history is retained after replacement or deletion
backend/src/services/content-revisions.test.ts and project-lock.test.ts exercise stale edits, separate-connection locks, restoration, isolation and history media retention

workflows.requirement: Invitations, acceptance, project switching and project lifecycle
evidence: Migrations 004/005 enforce canonical membership roles and store hashed expiring invitations; new and existing accounts accept after verified-email checks
Generated workspace and lifecycle API supports create, switch, versioned rename, confirmed deletion and atomic ownership transfer
Per-operation project selection prevents requests from another tab changing the target; stale subscription responses are discarded
Frontend project and member pages preserve errors and wait for acknowledgements; pending edits block project changes; deleted projects queue storage cleanup with retries
backend/src/services/project-workflows.test.ts, middleware/on-connect.test.ts and frontend/src/state/project.test.ts

workflows.requirement: Owner, administrator, editor and viewer permissions with role-aware UI
evidence: Owner/Admin/Editor/Viewer are shared domain roles, enforced at GraphQL roots and under lifecycle locks
Editor can change content and lists; Viewer reads; model, users, invitations and API keys require Admin/Owner; ownership operations require Owner
Required subscription roles are rechecked before every event; workspace notifications refresh revoked roles
Role-aware controls, keyboard actions, article editing, member actions and history restore are gated
Profile UI supports name changes, verification email resend and password changes that revoke other sessions
Real BetterAuth account integration test and three UI submission/error/acknowledgement tests pass

workflows.requirement: Draft content, preview, publication snapshots and rollback
evidence: Migration 006 adds project-scoped immutable publication pointers and publication history; default API keys serve only publications and preview keys follow saved draft revisions
Snapshot query runtime preserves SQL filter/order/list semantics; per-revision caches are checked against the database on every request
Publication and rollback check both draft and publication versions, validate required fields in list scopes, and keep the draft unchanged on publication rollback
Publication review, confirmation and rollback UI; immutable signed snapshot media survives draft replacement/deletion. Backend publication/filter/media integration and UI tests pass.

workflows.requirement: Versioned project export and import including media and round-trip tests
evidence: Versioned bounded gzip archives preserve model/settings/list content and checksummed verified media
New unpublished owned copies remap field/value/list/media IDs and article image references
Idempotent receipts, project/purpose validation, durable cleanup and source expiry protect failures and retries
Six backend archive and three UI tests pass, including actual media/article round trips, corruption, authorization and retry
Shared validated list requests bound page size, offsets, filters and search; exact parent list paths and field ownership are enforced
Typed number/date sorting occurs before pagination; totals, literal search, equality/contains/range/existence filters share a consistent database snapshot
List UI includes search, filter, sort, page size, pagination, empty/error/retry feedback and scoped caches that discard stale project/path responses
Backend list scope/sort/filter/limits tests and three UI control/retry/project isolation tests pass

workflows.requirement: Article images and media progress, metadata and cleanup
evidence: Verified immutable media registry; bounded byte/mime/image dimension checks and project/purpose scoping
Upload progress/cancellation and metadata acknowledge only finalized uploads; optional GraphQL null fields are omitted from durable JSON drafts
Tiptap verified image insertion and shared canonical article sanitizer retain stable image asset references in exports, publications and history
Durable per-file and deleted-project cleanup jobs preserve live/history/publication references and retry failures
Seven media integration tests, media/article/upload UI tests, and actual browser upload/public download pass

operations.requirement: Versioned production deployment package and reverse proxy
evidence: deploy/compose.yml, backend/frontend Dockerfiles and Caddyfile build and run from a fresh checkout configuration
Pinned PostgreSQL, SeaweedFS, Caddy and Node service images; versioned local application images and private backend/database ports
Actual Chromium registration, uploads, website consumer and recovery pass through the reverse proxy

operations.requirement: Validated configuration, registration policy and resource limits
evidence: Startup Zod validation checks origins, separate secrets, storage/email, registration, limits and retention without revealing values
setup-selfhost.mjs generates unique mode-0600 credentials; SMTP or SES delivery is configured
Invite-mode browser checks admit the bootstrap owner and invited editor and reject an uninvited account; query/body/field/upload/resource limits are enforced

operations.requirement: Tracked migrations and verified upgrade path
evidence: Ten ordered checksummed migrations run transactionally under an advisory lock; checksum mismatch and downgrade fail explicitly
Real PostgreSQL tests verify empty installation, idempotence and legacy project/model/settings/content preservation with plaintext key revocation
Restored deployment reruns the migration CLI and restarts the backend while preserving login, keys, publications, history and media

operations.requirement: Database and media backup and demonstrated restore
evidence: backup.sh freezes application/storage writes and backs up PostgreSQL, complete bundled media volume and configuration with checksums
restore.sh refuses populated database/media targets; verification rejects corrupted files, unsafe paths and links
verify-selfhost.sh demonstrates complete fresh-project restore and existing-key, account, role, draft/publication, media and history checks; refusal cases preserve the restored deployment

operations.requirement: Health, readiness, useful logs and draining shutdown
evidence: /health/live and /health/ready with migration/database/storage checks, request IDs and bounded HTTP/WebSocket operations
Structured route/status/duration logging omits secrets and request bodies
SIGTERM draining emits shutdown_started and shutdown_complete, awaits server/background cleanup and closes database/SDK clients; actual backup/restart check passes

operations.requirement: First-project guide, example consumer website, API and media documentation
evidence: Built-in /guide and complete operator/content/API documentation
Working server-rendered examples/consumer website uses a server-side key and stays on the publication while a draft changes
Browser installation checks follow the real guide link and complete the first-project workflow

evidence: MIT LICENSE and workspace license metadata
CHANGELOG.md, bug-report template and SECURITY.md document supported scope, upgrades and reporting
A named private maintainer contact, GitHub release publication and production rollout remain maintainer/operator actions

operations.requirement: End-to-end browser, concurrency, disconnection, permissions and staging verification
evidence: 341 unit/integration tests plus 7 deployed browser executions pass in the final checkpoint

Browser checks cover verified signup, invited editor, permission controls/revocation, modeling, media, publication/consumer, mistake restore, concurrent tabs, interrupted save/reload and project isolation
Clean installation, complete backup restore, migration restart, corrupt-backup rejection and populated-target refusal are automated in CI release-smoke

operations.requirement: Document and verify historical exposure cleanup for affected deployments
evidence: Tracked environment files and private test-data dump removed; check-secrets.mjs passes and is enforced in CI
Migration 002 revokes legacy plaintext API keys; new keys are displayed once and stored as SHA-256 fingerprints
Read-only history inspection confirms historical private files remain; SECURITY.md documents credential/session/key rotation and incident procedures
No external credentials were rotated and no Git history was rewritten; affected operators must complete that remediation before public use
